backups/FrequencyPicker.astro.rationale: Backup-cadence control (web-instant-webhook) composed from daisyUI radio rows (the wizard's schedule pattern) plus the Select and Button primitives; the Instant tier/dynamic-DB gating and save-error mapping live in lib/backups/frequency-picker.ts.

backups/LiveRefresh.astro.rationale: Freshness stamp + soft-primary Refresh button (ui-only@5572f8f promotion) shown in the Backups/Restore log toolbars while a run is in flight; a thin daisyUI Button composition (btn btn-sm btn-soft btn-primary) with a live 'updated Ns ago' stamp, not a standalone Storybook pattern. Styles live in global.css per catalog governance.

backups/RunBackupNowModal.astro.rationale: Thin product configuration of the ConfirmModal primitive — the credits-warning confirm for an on-demand backup. Documented via the confirm-modal styleguide entry; not a standalone pattern.

data/DataBrowse.astro.rationale: Data ▸ Records grid (Slice A Task 4, ui-only@9cf5b1ef): the record-browsing counterpart to Schema Browse. daisyUI-direct markup (table/input/badge/tabs) over an embedded SSR snapshot; the views/presets/filter-builder controller lives in its client <script>. Composes FacetFilter, TablePager, and patterns/ExportControl. Styles in <style is:global>.

data/DataChangelog.astro.rationale: Data ▸ Changelog (Slice A Task 4, ui-only@9cf5b1ef): run-over-run record changes on the shared changelog row grid. daisyUI-direct markup composing FacetFilter, DateRangePicker, TablePager and patterns/ExportControl; run-detail drill-in registers a panel kind in the shared PanelHost. Styles in <style is:global>.

data/DataComments.astro.rationale: Data ▸ Comments feed (Slice A Task 9, ui-only@9cf5b1ef; fed by server-comments-read): captured record comments on the shared changelog row grid, newest-first, grouped by date/base/table. daisyUI-direct markup composing FacetFilter, DateRangePicker, TablePager and patterns/ExportControl; each row opens the record panel via PanelHost. Styles in <style is:global>, every selector qualified by the .cm feed-root class so the shared .cl-* grid overrides never reach the sibling feeds.

data/DataMedia.astro.rationale: Data ▸ Attachments listing (Slice A Task 4, ui-only@9cf5b1ef): captured files as a table/grid with class/base/table/date facets. daisyUI-direct markup composing MediaThumb, FacetFilter, DateRangePicker, TablePager and patterns/ExportControl. Styles in <style is:global>.

data/LockedTab.astro.rationale: In-place locked-capability state (Slice A Task 4, ui-only@9cf5b1ef) for dynamic-only Data tabs on a static-only Space. Thin wrapper over the catalog EmptyState primitive (apps/web API).

data/MediaPanel.astro.rationale: Data ▸ Attachment detail sheet (Slice A Task 4, ui-only@9cf5b1ef): the asset: kind registered into the shared PanelHost stack. daisyUI-direct markup; opened from an Attachments row/tile. Styles in <style is:global>.

data/MediaThumb.astro.rationale: A captured file's thumbnail-or-glyph cell (Slice A Task 4, ui-only@9cf5b1ef), sized sm/md; renders the stored thumb when present, else the type glyph. daisyUI-direct markup used by DataMedia and MediaPanel. Styles in <style is:global>.

data/RecordPanel.astro.rationale: Data ▸ record detail sheet (Slice A Task 4, ui-only@9cf5b1ef): the record: kind registered into the shared PanelHost stack, opened from a Browse row / changelog record. daisyUI-direct markup rendering the shared record body (recordReadBody.ts). Styles in <style is:global>.

data/StaticImport.astro.rationale: Static-Space Browse fallback (Slice A Task 4, ui-only@9cf5b1ef): a simple CSV import/review table for Spaces that store files rather than a queryable store. daisyUI-direct markup; not mounted on the managed_pg dynamic path. Styles in <style is:global>.

integrations/BasePickerRow.astro.rationale: One base row of the workspace-grouped picker (checkbox leaf + provenance badges); split from BaseSelectionTable so the grid template is shared by head/group/row.

integrations/BaseSelectionTable.astro.rationale: Workspace-grouped base picker (ui-only@9a8b448 promotion) composed from daisyUI checkbox/toggle/progress/badge and the shared entity typeahead; groups bases by Airtable workspace from SSR-persisted identity, flat-table fallback, styles in global.css per governance.

layout/Inbox.astro.rationale: Notification-center side panel composed from daisyUI tabs (tabs-border lane switcher), badge (counts, Space and Handled chips), btn (row actions, Mark all read, Clear), and dropdown (the ff-trigger/ff-panel filter menu from the shared facet-filter stylesheet); Storybook documents structure and the zero-states, apps/design drives the fixture feed and triage behaviour.

patterns/AppShellHeader.astro.rationale: Application top bar built from daisyUI navigation and action primitives; Storybook documents structure, apps/design validates behavior.

patterns/AppShellSidebar.astro.rationale: Application sidebar shell with product navigation state; Storybook documents structure, apps/design validates behavior.

patterns/BackupHistoryWidget.astro.rationale: Backup history accordion composed from daisyUI badge, stats, alert, and button primitives.

patterns/BackupPipeline.astro.rationale: Product-specific Source to Bases to Destination pipeline, backed by Badge primitives.

patterns/BaseSelectionTable.legacy.astro.rationale: LEGACY rollback target for the workspace-grouped picker promotion (2026-07-29) — superseded by integrations/BaseSelectionTable.astro; unrouted, kept per the ui-sync promotion convention.

patterns/ConnectionHealthBanner.astro.rationale: App-shell connection-health warning bar composed from daisyUI alert-soft, the Button primitive, and Lucide icons; Storybook documents the state matrix, apps/design validates the collapse↔pill behavior.

patterns/ConnectionHealthPill.astro.rationale: Compact topbar form of the connection-health banner (daisyUI alert-soft pill); shares getBannerConfig with the bar and re-expands it.

patterns/DefinitionList.astro.rationale: Entity detail pages repeat the same term/value metadata layout.

patterns/EntityDetailHeader.astro.rationale: Product detail header composing PageHeader, Badge, and action controls.

patterns/ExportControl.astro.rationale: One export affordance per Schema tab, repurposing catalog primitives — the daisyUI dropdown/join/btn set plus the shared ff-trigger/ff-panel facet language — and replacing the per-tab divergent format pickers with a single scope-aware, format-named control.

patterns/MetaBlock.astro.rationale: Backup run KPI/meta blocks with mono tabular numbers.

patterns/RegistryTable.astro.rationale: Dense registry row/grid composition for Sources and Destinations lists.

patterns/RunBackupButton.astro.rationale: Manual backup CTA built from daisyUI Button plus loading and error states.

patterns/SelectableConnectorRow.astro.rationale: Selectable provider rows with status badges and radio/checkbox controls.

patterns/SpacePipelineHero.astro.rationale: Unconfigured Space pipeline hero composing Button and brand marks.

patterns/WizardStepper.astro.rationale: Setup flow stepper chrome for gated wizard surfaces.

schema/EntitySearch.astro.rationale: Shared entity typeahead (ui-only@9a8b448) — one search field that filters in place and offers a grouped dropdown; reused by the base picker and Schema Browse; styles in global.css.

schema/FacetFilter.astro.rationale: Faceted single/multi-select filter trigger + menu (promoted with Data surface, ui-only@9cf5b1ef): daisyUI dropdown/checkbox/radio markup driving the Data toolbar's Base/Table/type/date facets. Client filtering + emitted events live in its <script>. Styles via shared facet-filter.css.

ui/Alert.astro.rationale: Reusable inline notice primitive backed by daisyUI soft alert classes.

ui/Avatar.astro.rationale: Reusable identity primitive backed by daisyUI avatar classes.

ui/BackLink.astro.rationale: Reusable back navigation affordance for detail and setup pages.

ui/Badge.astro.rationale: Reusable status/count primitive backed by daisyUI badge classes.

ui/Breadcrumbs.astro.rationale: Reusable drill-down navigation primitive backed by daisyUI breadcrumbs.

ui/Button.astro.rationale: Primary action primitive backed by daisyUI button classes.

ui/Card.astro.rationale: Reusable surface primitive backed by daisyUI card styling.

ui/Checkbox.astro.rationale: Reusable boolean input primitive backed by daisyUI checkbox styling.

ui/CodeInput.astro.rationale: Short numeric-code primitive (2FA challenge, code-gated disable). One real input painted as N aria-hidden cells (styles/components/code-input.css) so paste/backspace/auto-advance stay native and AT hears one labelled field. Promoted from ui-only as a Settings SecurityPanel dependency (web-settings); full AuthChallengeView promotion is a later phase.

ui/ConfirmModal.astro.rationale: Reusable confirmation-dialog primitive built on the Modal primitive (daisyUI dialog) — Cancel + a confirm action with an optional consequence Alert.

ui/CreateSpaceModal.astro.rationale: Behavior-bearing modal composed from daisyUI dialog, Button, and TextInput; Storybook documents structure and apps/design validates behavior.

ui/DateRangePicker.astro.rationale: Snapshot-anchored day-window / event-window filter (promoted with Data surface, ui-only@9cf5b1ef): daisyUI dropdown of presets + custom range, emitting a from/to window anchored to the backup as-of. Styles in <style is:global>.

ui/Divider.astro.rationale: Reusable separator primitive backed by daisyUI divider classes.

ui/EmptyState.astro.rationale: Reusable empty/no-match state primitive for registries and setup screens.

ui/Modal.astro.rationale: Reusable dialog primitive backed by daisyUI modal/dialog markup.

ui/PageHeader.astro.rationale: Reusable page title, metadata, and action cluster primitive.

ui/PanelHost.astro.rationale: The single shared multi-panel drawer stack (Oleh's law, promoted with Data surface, ui-only@9cf5b1ef): mounts one createPanelStack whose hooks dispatch through the kind registry (record: / asset: / run:). daisyUI-direct chrome; contributing kinds register from their own components. Styles in <style is:global>.

ui/ProgressBar.astro.rationale: Reusable progress/quota primitive backed by daisyUI progress classes.

ui/SectionPanel.astro.rationale: Reusable section surface for repeated bordered panels.

ui/Select.astro.rationale: Reusable select primitive backed by daisyUI select classes.

ui/TablePager.astro.rationale: The one list pager (pattern-table-toolbar, ui-only@9cf5b1ef): a daisyUI Select (rows-per-page) + '1–N of M' range + prev/next btn-square-ghost buttons. Inert markup paired with createPager (./tablePager) for behaviour; a shared daisyUI composition rather than a bespoke Storybook primitive. Global .tpg styles (is:global) so runtime-innerHTML pagers reach them.

ui/Tabs.astro.rationale: Reusable in-page tab primitive backed by daisyUI tabs.

ui/TextInput.astro.rationale: Reusable text field primitive backed by daisyUI input/fieldset patterns.

ui/Toggle.astro.rationale: Reusable boolean switch primitive backed by daisyUI toggle styling.
